plan.title: Phone app: visual pass, faint logo watermark, logo sting on first load, appearance setting in /m
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One operator-visible visual pass across the two phone surfaces (/m web shell and the Capacitor app), which must ship one visual language together: both import the same new brand, appearance and sting components, so splitting would ship a half-restyled app or two diverging styles. Most extra files are co-located tests, acceptance PNG globs and the three existing Playwright specs that only gain a one-line sessionStorage seed.

narratives.Problem: The phone app (/m and the Capacitor app) looks unfinished: a plain text header crowded by two wrapped hint strings, text-only tabs, one-line grey empty states, no brand mark, and no appearance control in /m (PAN-5041's System/Light/Dark exists only in the native Settings screen).
narratives.Proposal: Share the appearance store from a frontend leaf module (src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/appearance.ts) and add a /m controller that applies it without writing overdeck.ui.theme or calling /api/settings/ui-theme; a shared AppearanceChoice used by native Settings and a new /m settings sheet; shared brand pieces (lockup, watermark, empty state, row classes, screen header) used by both surfaces; a WAAPI logo sting overlay that plays once per sessionStorage lifetime, skips on tap, and is static under reduced motion; restyled /m header, tab bar, rows, empty states and native machine list/sign-in/settings; a dismissible hints banner; before/after screenshots at iPhone 14 and Pixel 7, light and dark.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No restyle of PairScreen, RemovedScreen, MobilePairScreen, MobileIssueSheet, the question card body, or ConversationPanel
- No change to data-theme (Broadsheet/Ledger) in either surface
- No Settings button in the native MobileApp header; native appearance stays in the native Settings screen
- No sting on warm resume of the native app, on later /m loads in the same tab session, or on a /m deep-link open
- No guide rings, halo, tagline or mono label from the video recipe; no GSAP or any new npm dependency
- No change to the desktop dashboard theme behavior, toggleTheme, setTheme, or the /api/settings/ui-theme route
- /m must never write localStorage['overdeck.ui.theme'] or send PUT /api/settings/ui-theme
- No change to PAN-5045 grouping logic, ordering or its storage key
- No badge count on the tab bar
- No native iOS/Android code changes

autoDecisions.summary: The /m Settings button and sheet render only in the web shell; the native app keeps appearance in its own Settings screen.
autoDecisions.rationale: Native Settings already owns appearance plus the native chrome sync (PAN-5041); one entry point per surface avoids two screens for one setting.

autoDecisions.summary: /m defaults to System when overdeck.appearance is unset.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires the native shell's storage key and semantics, and the native default is System.

autoDecisions.summary: The sting fades at the later of a 1.3 s minimum and the moment content is ready, capped at 2.3 s; a /m deep-link open skips it and still marks it played.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says the sting never delays usable content; the minimum keeps the brand moment visible on a warm cache, and a notification-style deep link should land straight on its subject.

autoDecisions.summary: Under reduced motion the sting shows the settled lockup for 600 ms and is removed without a fade.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for the settled logo without motion; a short hold keeps the brand moment without delaying content.

autoDecisions.summary: Visual-pass scope is the /m header, tab bar, banner, three tab lists and empty states, plus native MachinesScreen, SignInScreen and SettingsScreen; other screens keep their layout.
autoDecisions.rationale: These are the screens the issue names (header, rows, empty states, tab bar, machine list, Settings); the rest are flows the operator did not mention.

autoDecisions.summary: Ship as one PR with plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: Both surfaces must land one shared visual language together; the shared components make the work inseparable.

autoDecisions.summary: Native machine-list screenshots come from the iOS Simulator or an Android emulator, else a recorded deviation.
autoDecisions.rationale: There is no browser harness for the native shell; the /m screenshots are always produced.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5, D-9..D-13. Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/mobile/LogoSting.tsx exporting LOGO_STING_KEY='overdeck.logoSting.played', MIN_STING_MS=1300, STING_MS=2300, FADE_MS=250, REDUCED_HOLD_MS=600 and LogoSting({ ready, skip }). Initial phase from a pure sessionStorage read ('done' when skip or already played; StrictMode-safe); a mount effect always writes the key. The fade starts at max(MIN_STING_MS, time ready first became true, measured with Date.now()), capped by the STING_MS timer. Five WAAPI animations per the D-12 table when Element.prototype.animate exists and reduced motion is off; ring uses pathLength=1 in a rotate(-90 20 20) group; satellite arc = five translate keyframes; wordmark = HTML span with clip-path inset. Removal is setTimeout-driven only. pointerdown skips. Reduced motion (matchMedia in JS): no animate calls, removed after REDUCED_HOLD_MS with no fade. Overlay: fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-background aria-hidden data-component=logo-sting data-state. Add src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/mobile/__tests__/LogoSting.test.tsx with fake timers (vi.useFakeTimers + vi.advanceTimersByTime; never real waits).
